:::note[About this reference]
This reference is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definitions are in the S1000D specification.
:::

Each page covers one attribute: the elements that carry it, the allowed values, the related rules, and how the S1000D Stack tools handle it. The allowed values are shown separately for the XML schema and for the default BREX.

## Attributes

The following 17 attributes have a page. Only the attributes whose values have been described in this project's own words are listed; more attributes will be added over time.

| Attribute | What it indicates |
| --- | --- |
| [`changeMark`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-mark/) | The attribute that states whether a visual indication, such as a change bar, is displayed next to a changed element. |
| [`changeType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-type/) | The attribute that states the type of a change in the change markup of an element. |
| [`countryIsoCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/country-iso-code/) | The attribute that gives the country where the language is spoken. |
| [`emphasisType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/emphasis-type/) | The attribute that gives the type of an emphasis (`emphasis`) inside text. |
| [`infoCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/info-code/) | A part of the data module code (DMC): the information code that states what type of information a data module holds. |
| [`infoCodeVariant`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/info-code-variant/) | A part of the data module code (DMC): the variant of the information code. |
| [`internalRefTargetType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/internal-ref-target-type/) | The attribute that states what type of target an `internalRef` (a reference inside the same data module) points to. |
| [`inWork`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/in-work/) | The attribute that gives the in-work number of a data module. |
| [`issueNumber`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/issue-number/) | The attribute that gives the issue number of a data module or a data management list. |
| [`issueType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/issue-type/) | The attribute that states what kind of issue an issue of a CSDB object, such as a data module, is. |
| [`itemLocationCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/item-location-code/) | The last character of the data module code (DMC). |
| [`languageIsoCode`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/language-iso-code/) | The attribute that gives the language of a data module. |
| [`listItemPrefix`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/list-item-prefix/) | The attribute that gives the symbol placed before the items of an unordered list (such as `randomList`). |
| [`reasonForUpdateRefIds`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/reason-for-update-ref-ids/) | The attribute that points from an element with change markup to the `id` of the `reasonForUpdate` that gives the reason for the change. |
| [`securityClassification`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/security-classification/) | The attribute that gives the security classification. |
| [`updateHighlight`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/update-highlight/) | The attribute that states whether a reason for update (`reasonForUpdate`) appears in the highlights data module. |
| [`updateReasonType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/update-reason-type/) | The attribute that states what type of change a reason for update (`reasonForUpdate`) describes when a data module is revised. |
